o: traffic goes through Cloudflare, hiding the origin IP

q: Which SSL/TLS mode should you use with a valid origin certificate?
why: Encrypted and verified all the way.

q: Flexible mode plus an origin that redirects HTTP to HTTPS causes …
why: Cloudflare talks HTTP to the origin, which redirects back to HTTPS, forever.

q: With proxied records, the origin is automatically unreachable directly.
why: Myth. Its IP may still leak; firewall it to Cloudflare ranges or use a Tunnel.
